grades.main_gap: Core content unproven: finiteness of primes appearing (Lemma 2), ubiquitous prime lemma (conjecture only), stabilization, and backward extension are all explicitly left open; only a reformulation and a pigeonhole lemma are proved.
grades.notes: Correct: hitting-set reformulation of the greedy rule and Lemma 1 (trivial pigeonhole). Part 5's merge-of-progressions argument is a reasonable conditional sketch, but rests on unproven lemmas; Part 3's monotonicity claim is also flawed. Essentially the main argument is absent.
